text:
maria: Heads-up, PR #36200 is blocked on CI — webhook-e2e failing intermittently on macOS-12. :cry:
jack: I saw that, failing at the same test `TestWebhookDelivery`. Logs show a 500 from our stub server.
ryan: Can someone paste the failing stack or a small log? I can't repro locally.
maria: here are the failing lines from the job run: 
```
--- FAIL: TestWebhookDelivery (0.24s)
    webhook_test.go:142: expected status 200, got 500
    handler.go:78: panic: nil pointer
```
jack: looks like a timeout hitting our local mock, maybe the harness flaked. I triggered a rerun: `./scripts/ci-rerun --scope=webhook-e2e --target=pool3`
oncall-bot: CI rerun queued for PR #36200 by jack — job ids: 4829, 4830
maria: thanks. FYI this PR has LGTM from @sahana but needs infra approval for macOS workers to merge.
sahana: re-approving now. I've also added a snapshot update; small UI diff is intentional.
ryan: if it flakes again, can we pin to staged mock? i.e., use `MOCK_SERVER=stable` env for the run.
maria: good idea. If rerun still fails, I'll do a targeted rerun on pool4 and open a quick RFC to stabilize the mock.
jack: merge hold for now. @alex could you take a quick look at the panic trace? :eyes:
alex: on it — reproducing locally now, will post findings in ~30m.
maria: cool. if no further flakes after rerun, can we unblock merge window at EOD? :crossed_fingers:
jack: agreed, update status when rerun completes.
oncall-bot: CI job 4829 succeeded, 4830 failed with flake — requeued 4830
maria: re-ran 4830 pinned to pool4: success. merging after infra approves macOS label.
sahana: infra approved macOS-run, go ahead :thumbsup:
jack: merged into main. thanks everyone!
